{{Top}}
'''Duralium''' was a metallic substance used in shielding. It could be coupled with [[Lanthanide/Legends|lanthanide]] to make a strong alloy in armor plating. The [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center]] used this alloy.
